statutory_and_verification_bodies.full_name: Employer of Record or Independent Contractor Compliance
statutory_and_verification_bodies.scope: Remote cross-border payment and tax compliance (Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or local consultancy invoicing)

common_eligibility_patterns: Explicit 'Remote - US Only', 'Remote - EU Only', or 'W2 eligible' restrictions DISQUALIFY African residents
Verify overlap hours against candidate preference (e.g., exclude US PST/EST full night shifts if candidate requires normal local hours)
Verify stable internet, backup power, or equipment requirements stated in posting
scam_red_flags: Remote 'data entry' jobs promising unrealistic hourly USD pay with Telegram/WhatsApp interviews and fake check/equipment fees
Requests to pay for international background checks or software licenses upfront

provenance.review_note: Compiled from general knowledge. Portal domains, regulator names and eligibility patterns have not been verified in a live session. Verify each against the current official source before relying on it, and record what you verified here.
